Financed vehicles are a reported output, not proof that all replaced gasoline bikes or that AI made otherwise unavailable credit affordable. Borrower income, loan defaults, financing costs, electricity sources, and lifecycle emissions are not evaluated. General claims about EV operating costs cannot establish this program’s net benefit.
